objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, translated, invalidated, or reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type of the document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, additional information, or attachment.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for the document; abbreviations are not language-independent and are the same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Assigned consecutive number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document in the status network or workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are kept before physical deletion.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version of a document for translation.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulation or process at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Documented regulation or instruction for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Description of specific procedures within a guideline framework or process sequence, details, and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Documentation of detailed special work steps in sub-processes.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating a new document object.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or from which new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted PDF version displayed on the web after the document is saved.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data such as IT applications that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example and document property reference used for linking documents.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained via document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained via document properties.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using DHC VISION who can receive authorizations, workflow tasks, notifications, or participate in document processes.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned to roles, reader rights, distribution, or archive access.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User or user group allowed to view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Registered person who signs creation of the document in the first workflow step and may edit assigned change proposals.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with personal change rights on a document and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person who checks content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for the document and its content and who decides distribution to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Person who can translate released content into another language and cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group that retains read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change rights assigned to a group of users or persons for a document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to distribution for a document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Additional object added to a document, released and published directly via switches in properties and not subject to the main document release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document that belongs to a document and can be scheduled, edited, completed, and managed.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and started automatically in workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for reactivation of an invalidated document.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported processing for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, or translation approval.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed with or without electronic signature depending on workflow.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: E-mail informing users about workflow task status, release, change proposal, distribution, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Workflow-supported confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display filled based on distribution groups and documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents, instructions, acknowledgements, or workflow status.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Reference from a local addition document in a client to an original document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object and selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the defined document templates when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for external files or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata via document properties.

evts.name: maintain_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client in the local Office component.

evts.name: print_metadata
evts.description: Automatically print document metadata in the document using integrated TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current PDF version on the web.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Change released document content or properties, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Automatically link documents already in the system with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents, and master data.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign readers via a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign an author in the author field or author selection list.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers maintained in the reviewer attributes.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers maintained in the releaser attribute.

evts.name: assign_translator
evts.description: Assign participants for checking and releasing the translation in the properties dialog.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Add an object of type Additional Information to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark released attachments for archiving and archive them with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the 3-step release process after document creation, maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes release so that the document is finally released, automatically published, and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: System informs users by e-mail notification about status and existence of workflow tasks or other process events.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participant completes a workflow task with an electronic signature where required.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new version in editing status when a valid and released document is revised or a change proposal is scheduled.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting the content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: print_change_proposal
evts.description: Print change proposals in a document for information purposes if the document is being revised.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the validity expires.

evts.name: check_extended_validity
evts.description: Releaser or all users involved in the release process check extended validity with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the validity extension request, keep the current document version valid, and update valid until.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Author creates a new version and updates the document when it needs to be revised.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a new revised version is released or Out of force is declared based on validity check.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for processing the request for AKS.

evts.name: check_aks
evts.description: Check AKS by releaser or in three steps by request creator, reviewer, and releaser.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document and its attachments invalid and archive them by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for a request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the reactivation request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of the invalidated document, retain metadata and properties, set authorizations, confirm distribution list, and reactivate archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain the distribution list in the cockpit for the document.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request active acknowledgement by e-mail upon release for persons and user groups maintained for acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the relevant document without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team as soon as all persons maintained in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups per document.

evts.name: list_document
evts.description: List all documents relevant to the user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: display_document_details
evts.description: Display detailed information such as attachments, additional information, referenced documents, and language versions when a document is selected.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, acknowledgements, or workflow status depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated language version so it is visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_addition_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from the extended local document to the original document.
